ios.desc:
KeePassium is an open-source password manager compatible with KeePass/KeePassXC. 

Built for IT professionals, power users and privacy enthusiasts, it keeps your data under your control. KeePassium is offline by default, open to review, and independently audited by Cure53.


Security

• Offline by default — privacy you can verify
• Face ID / Touch ID — secure access without typing
• Passkeys and one-time codes — when you need more than a password
• YubiKey support — strong, hardware-backed protection [Premium]
• Password leak audit — detects compromised passwords [Premium]


Convenience

• Password AutoFill — automatically sign in to apps and websites
• Automatic sync — optional, works with major cloud providers or your own server
• Multiple databases — share passwords with family and team members [Premium]
• Quick registration — create new accounts without switching apps [Premium]
• Enterprise storage — keep work passwords in your company’s cloud [Premium]


Compatibility

• Works with KeePass, KeePassXC, and other KeePass-compatible apps
• Supports VoiceOver and large text sizes for accessibility
• Premium license covers both iOS and macOS


…and of course

• No vendor lock-in
• No analytics
• No ads


Privacy

KeePassium does not collect any personal data. We sell the app, not its users.
